shareText: 🏴‍☠️Intresting facts:📽️Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl follows Captain Jack Sparrow and blacksmith Will Turner as they race to rescue Elizabeth Swann from the cursed crew of the Black Pearl. Led by Captain Barbossa, the pirates are doomed to live as undead skeletons until stolen Aztec gold is returned. Filled with sword fights, adventure, humor, and betrayal, the film tells a thrilling story of friendship, freedom, and redemption on the high seas.
